summary: Verified fix allowing non-admin users to add master names. Backend: 32 pytest cases across /api/master/{customers,companies,executives,managers} - manager & agent POST return 200 with persisted data visible to admin; PUT/DELETE return 403 for manager; unauthenticated POST rejected; duplicate/empty name return 400; admin PUT/DELETE still work. Frontend: logged in as manager, opened Month MIS -> Apr-2026 group -> Add Entry, used '+' inline add for Customer (TestMgrCustQA7X / 9990001111), Executive, Team Manager - all saved with success toast, dialog closed, value auto-selected in the Select trigger, contact auto-filled, and new customer present in dropdown options. Logged in as admin -> Master File shows all three names in Customer Names, Executive Names, Team Managers. Test data cleaned up.

design_issues.screen: Month MIS Add New Entry dialog
issues: Date / Login Date / Disbursed Date use native browser date inputs (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar component - pre-existing, not part of this fix

critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/master/companies is now open to all roles, but the MIS Add/Edit form has no inline '+' next to 'Company Name *' - non-admins still cannot add a company from the MIS page even though the API allows it. Consider adding the inline add button for company for consistency.

Master POST endpoints read raw request bodies via `await request.json()` instead of Pydantic models; a non-string 'name' (e.g. {"name": 123}) would raise AttributeError -> 500. Low risk from the UI but worth tightening with a Pydantic model.
seed_data_creation: Created TestMgr*/TestAgent* master names during testing; all removed afterwards along with developer's MgrTestCustomer/MgrTestCompany/MgrTestExec/MgrTestMgr via /app/backend/tests/cleanup_master_qa.py

context_for_next_testing_agent: Month MIS groups are collapsed by default; click [data-testid^='month-header-'] then [data-testid^='add-entry-']. Inline add flow testids: inline-add-{customer|executive|manager}-btn, inline-add-name-input, inline-add-contact-input, inline-add-save-btn. Navigating to /login while a session exists redirects to '/' - clear localStorage before switching users. Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_master_nonadmin_add.py (32 tests, all passing).
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: POST master endpoints called check_admin, causing 403 for Manager/Agent from the MIS inline add. Fix (check_admin removed from the 4 POST handlers) is confirmed correct; PUT/DELETE retain check_admin so edit/delete stay admin-only.
